How to play

Build the best five-card hand from your two private cards and the five shared cards on the table.

  • Check — stay in for free when there’s no bet to match.
  • Call — match the current bet to keep playing.
  • Raise — increase the bet using the slider and pressure your opponents.
  • Fold — give up the hand and lose nothing more.

Shortcuts: F fold · C check/call · R raise
